title: Removes the payment method types parameter from Payment Intents and Setup Intents
summary: Removes payment_method_types as a writable parameter from the create, update, and confirm methods on Payment Intents, and from the create and update methods on Setup Intents. Passing payment_method_types on this API version returns a 400 error with the code payment_method_types_no_longer_supported. Previously, payment_method_types accepted a list of payment method types to explicitly set which methods are available on a PaymentIntent or SetupIntent. This parameter is no longer writable. Requests that pass payment_method_types on the affected endpoints return a 400 error.
migrationNotes: If your integration passes payment_method_types when creating, updating, or confirming a Payment Intent or Setup Intent, remove it before upgrading to API version 2026-08-26.preview. Replace it with dynamic payment methods (optionally combined with excluded_payment_method_types), or use allowed_payment_method_types. Dynamic payment methods automatically handle compatibility filtering, so you no longer need to maintain eligibility logic in your code.
